summary: Alps Group Inc filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Mr. Hee H. Lee as an independent director, increasing the board from five to six members. Mr. Lee, a former Ernst & Young partner with over 30 years in financial services, will serve on the Audit and Compensation Committees. This is a routine board appointment with no forced departure or abrupt change disclosed. The filing includes a press release. While it involves a management change, it is not abrupt or forced, so the category is borderline, but it fits best as a routine governance update. No deal terms are stated.
